description: Player 2 deck for spec 31 (section 10.5, R17, R448). This is spec 03 player 2 deck (03-sheepish-b) with #41 Sheepish swapped for C #17 Counterspell and #1 Big D Fender swapped for #60 Bear Honeypot. These are the only two Traps in either deck. Bear Honeypot springs on any 1-cost card player 1 plays, so set beside Counterspell it is the trap a countered 1-cost Spell would have reached: R17 says a countered card reaches no other trap. Counterspell answers Spells only, so the Unit player 1 plays next is not countered and springs the Honeypot, which shows that the Honeypot was armed all along.
